name: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Integration
description: Integration pack for Google Cloud Platform (GCP), providing connectivity to GCP Workload Identity Federation, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Google Cloud Storage (GCS), Cloud IAM, and Cloud Logging/Monitoring (Operations Suite).

capabilities.name: Infrastructure Management / Monitoring, Observability & SRE
capabilities.description: Integrates GCP Compute Engine, GKE cluster management, VPC subnets, and Cloud Storage buckets. Integrates Google Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring metrics, and Trace.

capabilities.name: Platform & Developer Experience
capabilities.description: Integrates GCP Workload Identity Federation and gcloud SDK credentials.

checklists.name: GCP Integration Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for GCP Workload Identity, GKE cluster access, and Cloud Operations Suite alerts.

items.statement: GCP Workload Identity Federation authenticates service accounts without long-lived service account key files.
GKE cluster credentials obtain via gcloud container clusters get-credentials.
Google Cloud Monitoring Alert Policies dispatch webhook notifications on log metric thresholds.

reviewGates.name: GCP Cloud Integration Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The GCP Cloud Architect confirms that Workload Identity and Cloud Monitoring alerts operate properly.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the GCP integration verify Workload Identity authentication and GKE cluster access?

obligationDefinitions.title: GCP service account keys must be rotated on a recurring cadence
obligationDefinitions.description: Long-lived GCP service account JSON keys used by this integration must be rotated periodically, preferring Workload Identity Federation where possible; an un-rotated static key is a standing credential risk.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Every service account key in use is rotated within the declared cadence, or migrated to Workload Identity Federation.

requiredEvidence.title: Service account key rotation record
requiredEvidence.description: IAM record of service account key age and rotation.
